# HS GPA Calc

> Free, private high school GPA calculator. Calculates weighted and unweighted GPA on 4.0, plus/minus and 4.33 scales with AP, Honors, IB and Dual Enrollment classes, per year and cumulative. Runs entirely in the browser; no sign-up. Available in English and Spanish, plus a German Abitur calculator.

## Tools
- [High School GPA Calculator](https://hsgpacalc.com/): the calculator, plus FAQ and what counts as a good GPA
- [Cumulative GPA Calculator](https://hsgpacalc.com/cumulative-gpa-calculator/): combine term GPAs, weighted by credits
- [Raise GPA Calculator](https://hsgpacalc.com/raise-gpa-calculator/): average needed next term to reach a target GPA
- [Calculadora de GPA (Español)](https://hsgpacalc.com/es/): Spanish version
- [German Grade to GPA Converter](https://hsgpacalc.com/german-grade-to-gpa/): German grade (Note) ⇄ US GPA via the modified Bavarian formula, with full chart
- [Note in GPA umrechnen (Deutsch)](https://hsgpacalc.com/de/note-in-gpa-umrechnen/): German version of the converter
- [Abi-Rechner (Deutsch)](https://hsgpacalc.com/de/abi-rechner/): German Abitur grade calculator (Block I + Block II, KMK formula N = 17/3 − E/180)

## Guides
- [What Is a Good GPA in High School?](https://hsgpacalc.com/what-is-a-good-gpa/): common GPAs compared with the 3.11 national average
- [How to Calculate Your High School GPA](https://hsgpacalc.com/how-to-calculate-gpa/): formula and worked examples for unweighted, weighted and cumulative GPA
- [Weighted vs Unweighted GPA](https://hsgpacalc.com/weighted-vs-unweighted-gpa/): differences and which colleges use
- [GPA Scale and Chart](https://hsgpacalc.com/gpa-scale-chart/): letter grade and percent to 4.0 / 4.33 points, with a percent converter
- [Weighted GPA Scale](https://hsgpacalc.com/ap-honors-gpa-weights/): what each grade is worth in Regular, Honors and AP classes
